name: whynot-cut
description: Raw footage in, Premiere project out. Why not? AI post-production for vertical reels (Arabic/English) on macOS and Windows: guided setup, drop-in client folders, Whisper transcript, dialogue cleanup and pause removal, story-driven brand graphics and animated captions, a watchable preview video, a native Adobe Premiere Pro build through a bridge panel, and evidence-based QC. Podcast mode: a finished episode becomes a reels plan with timecodes and content types, the editor picks, each reel is framed per shot and edited by its recipe, plus the YouTube/social publish package. A lead-editor skill coordinates 17 specialist agents; hooks keep client sources read-only.

clients_root.title: Client folders location
clients_root.description: Folder that contains your client folders (each with assets/ and data/), e.g. D:\WhyNot Clients or ~/Documents/WhyNot Clients. /whynot-cut:start can set this up for you.

engine_home.title: Engine data folder
engine_home.description: Where the Python environment, Whisper models (~3 GB) and the Premiere job queue live. Leave empty for ~/.whynot-cut (an existing ~/.reel-editor install is reused).
